world.title: Trump vows new US air show will be biggest in the world
world.summary: US President Donald Trump and NASA announced plans for a new space and aeronautics industry conference, named CapeWeek, aimed at becoming the largest air show globally. The initiative seeks to surpass existing major air shows in other countries, highlighting the United States' commitment to advancing its aerospace sector. Details about the event's location and dates have yet to be revealed.

world.title: Man with guns arrested near White House, had said he heard voices telling him to kill Trump
world.summary: A Venezuelan man, Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos, was arrested near the White House after allegedly threatening to kill President Trump. Authorities discovered three guns in his vehicle. The arrest occurred on November 5 when officers noticed suspicious behavior from Chrinos, who reportedly claimed to hear voices instructing him to commit the act. The investigation is ongoing.

world.title: US military carries out new targeted strike on Iran as Tehran’s leaders weigh mediator’s proposals
world.summary: The US military conducted targeted strikes on Iran, focusing on its air defense systems, as announced by President Donald Trump. The strikes occurred early Saturday, with Iranian state media reporting two explosions in the Suza area of Qeshm Island. This action comes as Tehran's leaders consider proposals from mediators amid ongoing tensions between the two nations.

business.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
business.summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised $11 billion in a new funding round, which is expected to close in the coming weeks. This funding values the AI lab at $1.25 trillion. Bloomberg cited sources familiar with the matter regarding the new funding. The reported amount is part of a larger funding initiative aimed at supporting OpenAI's ongoing projects and developments.

business.title: SEBI's new settlement regulations to come into effect from November 7, online application facility introduced
business.summary: SEBI's new settlement regulations will take effect on November 7, introducing an online application facility. The regulations stipulate a non-refundable application fee of Rs 25,000 for natural persons and Rs 35,000 for other applicants. This initiative aims to streamline the settlement process and enhance accessibility for various stakeholders involved in financial transactions and regulatory compliance.

business.title: Sensex jumps 10.6% in 7-session pre-Diwali rally, best in 35 years
business.summary: The Sensex surged 10.6% over seven sessions leading up to Diwali, marking its best performance in 35 years. The index closed more than 8.8% higher in a single week, driven by renewed foreign investment in Indian stocks. Optimism surrounding the US midterm elections contributed to expectations of policy stability, further boosting investor confidence in the Indian market.

technology.title: GTA 6 Xbox file size leak differs from PS5, with release day patch possible
technology.summary: The Xbox Store lists the file size for GTA 6 at 209.86 GB, while backend data suggests it could be 225.34 GB, possibly including a day-one patch. Pre-loads for both Xbox and PS5 begin on November 9th/10th, ahead of the game's release on November 19th. This information helps users prepare for the required storage space.

technology.title: This Early Black Friday Price Drop Brings Apple's M5 MacBook Air to Its Lowest Price Ever
technology.summary: Amazon is currently offering a $250 discount on select models of the M5 MacBook Air, marking the lowest price ever for these laptops. Known for their high quality, Apple laptops typically come with a significant price tag, making this early Black Friday deal an attractive option for consumers looking to purchase a new MacBook at a reduced cost.

technology.title: Windows 11 users won't get Windows 12 in 2027, just a new wallpaper instead, as Microsoft retires Bloom
technology.summary: Microsoft is set to release Windows 11 version 27H2 in 2027, instead of introducing Windows 12. This update will serve as a full operating system swap, similar to the previous 24H2 version, focusing on quality and performance enhancements. Additionally, the new update will feature a new wallpaper, replacing the existing Bloom design.

sports.title: 'It was all of us' - Khawaja exposes sandpaper details from 2018
sports.summary: Usman Khawaja is set to release an autobiography detailing his perspective on the 2018 sandpaper scandal. In an interview with Nine papers, he stated he was never interviewed by Cricket Australia regarding the incident in Cape Town. Khawaja emphasized that the responsibility for the events was shared among the entire Australian team, suggesting a collective involvement.

sports.title: Mohammed Shami retires from Test cricket
sports.summary: Mohammed Shami, the 36-year-old Indian fast bowler, has announced his retirement from Test cricket. He concludes his career as the sixth-most successful fast bowler for India. Shami's contributions to the team have been significant, particularly noted for his performance in the second innings of matches. His retirement marks the end of an impactful era in Indian cricket.

sports.title: WTA Chennai Semifinal Predictions
sports.summary: The WTA Chennai semifinals feature four players with different paths to the final four. Janice Tjen aims to defend her title after defeating Polina Kudermetova. Robin Montgomery also advanced, winning in straight sets against a local competitor. The matchups promise intriguing contests as each player seeks to secure a place in the final of the tournament.

health.title: Medical groups create framework to identify women’s cardiovascular risk
health.summary: Four medical societies have developed a framework and clinical guidance linking women's heart health to specific life stages. This initiative aims to assist clinicians in identifying cardiovascular risk factors more effectively and taking timely action. By focusing on the unique aspects of women's health, the framework seeks to enhance early detection and management of cardiovascular issues in women.

health.title: Trump Officials to Miss His Vaccine Recommendation Deadline
health.summary: Trump administration health officials are anticipated to miss the deadline set by President Trump for new childhood vaccination recommendations, which is due by Sunday. Sources familiar with the situation indicate that the officials have not finalized the recommendations in time. The deadline was established as part of an executive order aimed at addressing vaccination policies during Trump's presidency.

health.title: Why Is Everyone Bragging About Their Ferritin Levels?
health.summary: Experts are highlighting ferritin levels as a potential cause for symptoms like hair loss, fatigue, and brain fog. Wellness influencer Elizabeth Orringo suggests that low ferritin might be mistaken for depression or lack of motivation. This has led to increased discussions on social media, prompting individuals to check their ferritin levels as a possible solution to these issues.

science.title: ESA's Hera images Didymos from 60km revealing DART scars
science.summary: The European Space Agency's Hera spacecraft has obtained its first close-up image of the Didymos asteroid system from approximately 60 kilometers away. The images reveal boulders, craters, and grooves, which are likely scars from NASA's DART mission that impacted Dimorphos in 2022. This mission aims to gather detailed information about the effects of the DART impact.

science.title: MIT researchers defy 20-year rule with flexible polymers linking nanoparticles
science.summary: MIT researchers have developed a new method for assembling nanoparticles by utilizing flexible polymers as connectors, challenging a 20-year-old rule in materials science. This innovative approach has resulted in the creation of unprecedented crystal structures, showcasing the potential of floppy connectors over traditional rigid ones. The findings could significantly impact future research and applications in nanotechnology and materials development.

science.title: Scientists tested the six-tonne Altar Stone at Stonehenge after earlier research pointed to north-east Scotland, but a new November 5 study found no matching rock source there, leaving its ancient jou
science.summary: Scientists tested the six-tonne Altar Stone at Stonehenge, following earlier research suggesting a source in north-east Scotland. However, a study conducted on November 5 found no matching rock source in that region. This discovery adds to the ongoing mystery surrounding Stonehenge, one of the most recognizable prehistoric monuments, which continues to reveal secrets about its origins.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 7, 2026, Taurus is advised to move beyond survival mode and heed their instincts, which are guiding them toward a specific direction. The horoscope suggests that Taurus has two potential paths to consider and emphasizes the importance of paying close attention to the signs and guidance available. This period calls for careful decision-making and reflection.

entertainment.title: Aries Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 7, 2026, Aries individuals are encouraged to embark on an adventure with confidence. As circumstances seem to slow down, it's essential to take time for introspection. Exploring various approaches to current challenges is advised, allowing for deeper understanding and flexibility in decision-making. This period emphasizes the importance of reflection and considering multiple perspectives in life’s situations.

entertainment.title: Virgo Horoscope Today: November 7, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 7, 2026, Virgos may experience tension in their workplace or personal life, feeling judged or taunted by someone. This situation could lead to feelings of being cornered or restricted. As a result, distancing oneself from the source of discomfort may become necessary. It is advised to navigate these challenges carefully to maintain personal well-being.
